text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Woooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Japan Cup. Agnes
Tachyon isn't
with us anymore, but the
two of us have still made
it this far.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Special Week and Silence Suzuka...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: They both have their own unique traits...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Special Week's power comes from the
sheer
volume of food she eats...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, my diet swings
between
extremes... There's no doubt
about it... that
power is unique to her.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
And Silence Suzuka hides her
extraordinary
intensity. An intensity I
don't have...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Her speed and skill as a front runner... is
just
what's on the surface... The true
source of her
strength is hidden deep
down...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
So what about Zenno Rob Roy? She's my

competition today.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I wonder what power she's hiding...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh... My greatest strength?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Yes... Would you be willing to tell me?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
W-well, none of my traits spring
immediately to
mind, but if I had to
say...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it would be my unbreakable
spirit.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: As in, your determination?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Races don't always take place when
I'm
feeling my very best. Sometimes, it's
the
opposite.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
But I could never hope to be a hero by
just giving
up. So, in every single race, I
aim for the best
possible position.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I strive to do my best.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I see... So that's how Zenno Rob Roy
does it...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: This must be... the final piece...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um... Cafe? Are you perhaps trying to
learn from
me?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Learn from you... No, I don't think that's
quite it.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I think... there's probably an
unbreakable spirit
inside me. But...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I've forgotten it... If I could just
remember it—that
feeling deep inside...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All the while she's been chasing after her
friend,
Manhattan Cafe has been piecing
things
together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And she might just find the final piece
she needs
at this Japan Cup.
